selection.rule: Earliest C_fit date with scored rows at all three stations and all17 satellite/R frames; initialization closest to 12:00 BJT, earlier tie; no errors used
selection.strict_first_attempt: No common initialization had all16 GHI labels in all3 stations; no data fabricated. Preserve partial GHI labels as gaps.
selection.usage: OOF explanatory case, not frequency estimate or independent test

display: Fixed C03/C02/C01 square-root 0..0.7 false colour; native 16x16 pixels; no enhancement/smoothing
GHI: Right-ending 15min means; three-base means only for plotting, not ensemble scoring
limits: Raw R-COT can exceed100; it is not independent truth. Actual future image/COT paths are offline. One calendar case does not estimate overall gain.
destination: Provisional research diagnostic, no journal-specific export claim
